subject: Pricing request: private deployment options for Storify
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@storify.ai>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@storify.ai; carolyn.ng@storify.ai
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Private deployment pricing request for Storify

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for taking the time on Friday. As discussed, our security team needs a clear pricing and packaging breakdown for two private options: (1) VPC-hosted (customer VPC, Redwood control plane) and (2) fully on-prem (air-gapped) with a private control plane. High level we need: licensing model (one-time vs annual platform fee), support tiers and SLAs, any required minimum commitments, and what migration/onboarding credits you can offer.

Storify's initial use case is high-volume search reranking and an internal agent for customer support — estimate 1B tokens/month after year one. We're sensitive to unit cost and would like to understand predictable monthly spend. Also please flag any additional professional services (migration, integration) and estimated timelines.

Could you send a short redlineable commercial summary we can share with procurement by EOD Thursday?

Best,
Liam

--
Liam O'Connor
Head of Platform Partnerships, Storify
liam.oconnor@storify.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@storify.ai>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, contracts@storify.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing request for Storify

Hi Liam — thanks, and great talking last week. Attached is a concise commercial summary and a pricing worksheet (Redwood_Private_Pricing_Sheet_v3.xlsx) that lays out baseline options. High level callouts below so procurement has context.

1) License & platform fee
   - Annual platform fee (managed control plane, telemetry, console): $150k/year (base) for VPC option; for fully on-prem the platform fee is $225k/year to cover private control plane and extra support.
   - Per-instance license unit (per provisioned inference pool): $X per GPU-hour equivalent (sheet has variable inputs).
   - Minimum annual commitment: $300k for VPC, $500k for on-prem.

2) Support tiers
   - Standard: 24x5 support, 12-hour P1 response, included with platform fee.
   - Enterprise: 24x7, 4-hour P1 response, dedicated TAM, prioritized escalations (+15% of platform fee).
   - Premium: 24x7 with 1-hour P1, on-call rotation for incidents (+30% of platform fee) and quarterly on-site reviews.

3) Migration & onboarding credits
   - We typically include a migration credit for multi-year commitments. Example: 12-month migration credit equal to 10% of first-year committed spend, or a flat $75k credit for a 36-month committed contract.

4) Discounts & term incentives
   - 10% discount for 24-month commitment, 16% for 36-month commitment. Additional volume banding available for >2B tokens/month.

5) Security/compliance add-ons
   - HSM/KMS integration, additional audit logging retention, and air-gap packaging are priced separately; see sheet and SOW (Storify_SOW_v1.pdf) for rough ranges.

Next steps: if this aligns, Laura (legal) can prepare a commercial term sheet + SOW redline. Monica, can you confirm estimated SE effort for full on-prem? Vivek, any executive notes on discount flexibility?

Thanks — I'll plan to follow up after your procurement review.

Regards,
Aisha
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aisha_rahman@redwood.ai
--
Attachments: Redwood_Private_Pricing_Sheet_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), Storify_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing request for Storify

Aisha / team — quick SE sizing notes:

- For VPC option: ~4 weeks for integration (networking, KMS, certs), ~1 engineer + TAM for 6 weeks.
- For fully on-prem (air-gapped): ~12-16 weeks, 2-3 engineers on site at peak, validation window for compliance teams.
- Estimate professional services: $120k for VPC onboarding; $420k for on-prem full delivery (includes on-site kickoff, load tests, and runbook handover).

I'll prepare a short line-item to add to the SOW so procurement can see PS as separate vs included credits. Also: the on-prem packaging requires 6 months lead time for our secure build and validation if they want a formal air-gap appliance.

-Monica
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing request for Storify

Folks — notes from legal on commercial flexibility:

- Migration credit structures are fine but need clear milestone definitions tied to invoice credits (e.g., credit applied after acceptance tests).
- We should avoid percentage discounts that compound with other credits; propose we offer either term discount OR migration credit, not both, unless it's >$1M ARR.
- Add a clause that support tiers include response SLAs but credits for missed SLAs are capped at 10% of monthly platform fee.

Recommendation to Sales: offer the 36-month option with $75k flat migration credit OR 16% term discount; for requests to stack both, escalate to Vivek for approval.

Laura
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@storify.ai>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, contracts@storify.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Final commercial summary: VPC & on-prem pricing for Storify

Hi Liam — following internal alignment, here's a concise commercial summary you can share with procurement. Attached: updated pricing worksheet and SOW.

Offer A — VPC (managed control plane)
- Annual platform fee: $140,000/year (introductory)
- Minimum annual commitment: $300,000
- Professional services (onboarding): $120,000 (separate line item)
- Support: Enterprise tier (24x7, 4hr P1) included for first 12 months
- Term incentives: 12% discount for 36-month commitment OR one-time $75,000 migration credit applied after acceptance testing.

Offer B — On-prem (private control plane / air-gapped)
- Annual platform fee: $200,000/year
- Minimum annual commitment: $500,000
- Professional services (on-prem delivery): $420,000 (separate)
- Support: Enterprise tier + quarterly on-site review (first 12 months included)
- Term incentives: 18% discount for 36-month commitment OR one-time $150,000 migration credit.

Notes:
- Discounts and migration credits are mutually exclusive per Laura's guidance; stacking requires executive approval.
- HSM/KMS integration and extended log retention priced per the SOW.
- Target start: onboarding kickoffs can begin 4 weeks after signed agreement for VPC; 12-16 weeks for on-prem.

If this looks good, contracts@storify.ai can send a preferred PO or markups and we'll have Laura upload a redlineable term sheet by Monday. Vivek — please confirm final approval for the on-prem migration credit if they request stacking.

Best,
Aisha
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
